blocker_definition_array.candidates_per_research_doc: EBOOT data segment, or a binary table adjacent to the name tables (a 2 KB pre-table region was captured by the mining lane for analysis).
blocker_definition_array.what: The sbcustomize_item_t definition array — per item: slot/category, price, character eligibility, model-pack reference. The name tables' item_idx byte is the join key to this array; without it, names cannot be assigned slots, prices, or characters from held data.

conclusion: Tekken 6 item NAME tables EXIST and are format-decoded — found by the tekken-mining lane (2026-10-16) inside the decrypted DATA401 bulk, documented on main in teardown/tekken6-customization-research.md, and RE-VALIDATED FIRST-HAND by this search on the SHA-256-verified recon-release bulk: 11,053 valid name records (record: u32 rec_size + u8 item_idx + null-padded ASCII name; item_idx range 1-160), with the full extraction (9,440 records in runs of 4+) shipped as tekken6-item-names.json. 120 NTXL string tables (per the research doc) carry the customization slot categories and shop/equip UI strings; one English NTXL table was spot-verified byte-for-byte at bulk offset 0x1AB2000. The item DEFINITION array (slot, price, character eligibility, model-pack reference per item — the sbcustomize_item_t instances) is still NOT located: that is the remaining gap, and it is why names cannot yet be joined to slots/prices/characters. The EBOOT-side evidence (pack formats, struct type, customize classes, 12 kkItemMotionTick handlers) is catalogued below.

customize_mode_classes.name: kwModelLayerControl_Paul_Hair (hair rendered as a model layer)

item_struct_type.meaning: RTTI proves a dedicated customize-item struct type held in a std::vector with the game's custom allocator. The type is corroborated by the mining lane's EBOOT findings (teardown/tekken6-customization-research.md section 1). The struct's instance array (definitions) is not in the EBOOT — see blocker_definition_array.
item_struct_type.name: sbcustomize_item_t

items_note: No per-item rows (name + slot + price + character) can be honestly emitted yet: names exist (item_name_tables) and the name record carries an item_idx join key, but the definition array that maps item_idx -> slot/price/eligibility/model-pack has not been located in any held data. Rows will be added when (a) the definition array is found in the bulk/EBOOT data segment, joining on item_idx. The Tekken 7 spec shape for the target rows: 21 fields (ShopID, packageIndex, CCI_Reference, Unknown_D, charId, slotId, Unknown_G, NameByID, ItemName, Unknown_J, SlotGroupID, Unknown_L, PlayerCusID, SlotColors, Unknown_O, Rarity, packageId, ItemCost, Unknown_S, AdditionalText, Unknown_U) per tekken7-slot-catalog.json; the T6-native equivalent is the sbcustomize_item_t array + name-table join.
